title: Crush Crush decoded save
description: Structured JSON produced by `tools/crushcrush_save.py decode` / consumed by `tools/crushcrush_save.py encode` (see tools/save_schema.py and CLAUDE.md's "JSON schema" section). One JSON file can be re-encoded to either PC or Switch format regardless of which platform it was decoded from.

$schema.description: Editor schema-association hint, not save data. Ignored on encode.

Player.description: Avatar/player-identity fields. Raw keys are Skill-prefixed (SkillGender etc) but are not per-hobby skill levels.

Inventory.description: Account-wide owned-costume bitmask, shares bit indices with girls' LifeOutfits/Clothing.

Participation.description: Bit index = parallel event ID (pes<N>); one bit permanently set per PE ever started.

AwardedItems.description: Normalized name for PC's BlayfapAwardedItems / Switch's PlayfabAwardedItems. Server-authoritative - local edits get overwritten on next launch.

Girls.description: Keyed by each girl's exact internal save name (e.g. "Cassie", "Pamulzebub", "Ayano" - never a display name).

PreviouslyUnlocked.description: Unlocked at least once this save, persists across resets.

Current.description: Index of the currently active girl.

Jobs.description: Keyed by exact job name, including "FAST FOOD" with its literal space.

Hobby.description: Keyed by hobby name (12 at root; different vocabulary per Parallel Event, see Events.PE).

Flings.description: Phone Flings. Keyed by numeric fling ID (string) - the ID has no fixed relationship to a girl's Girls-object entry.

Unlocked.description: Which fling IDs are unlocked at all.

Purchased.description: Purchased Core Girl flings, in fixed roster order (not fling ID order).

Achievement.description: Keyed by achievement ID (string, see docs/ACHIEVEMENTS.md). Each value is a bitmask where bit = tier reached; an ID with zero tiers earned is simply absent.

Bonuses.description: Shop bonus pricing/quantities. PC-only in practice - absent on Switch saves.

Albums.description: Memory Album unlock trackers (Switch-only in the samples seen). Keyed by album ID (0-5).

additionalProperties.description: Byte index (little-endian) -> bit index within that byte -> true for set bits. Sparse: an absent byte/bit means unset.

LTE.description: Completed limited-time events (bit index = LTE ID). Was the raw format's Completed.Events - renamed to avoid an Events.Completed.Events repeat.

PE.description: Parallel events, keyed by PE ID (string, see docs/EVENTS.md). Each mirrors the same per-type shapes as root.

LTE.description: Limited-time events, keyed by LTE ID (string). Tasks present only for the LTE matching Events.Current.

AchievementCount.description: Total achievement tiers unlocked across all IDs (derived total, redundant with Achievement).

dchk.description: Unconfirmed - likely analytics/checksum, safe to ignore.

ana.ev.description: Unconfirmed - likely analytics, safe to ignore.

ana.vid.description: Unconfirmed - likely analytics, safe to ignore.

SaveFileVersion.description: Unconfirmed - a version number was expected here, not a flag.

CabinFeverSave.description: Switch-observed. Whether a "Cabin Fever" save was detected; unlocks Mallory.

AyanoChibi2017.description: Switch-observed. Likely tracker for the 2017 "Don't Notice Me, Senpai" event.

CurrentPanel.description: Switch-observed. Likely which UI panel/tab was open when the save was written.

TutorialStep.description: Switch-observed. Separate step counter from Tutorial.

TutorialAffection.description: Switch-observed. Likely completion flag for an "affection" tutorial step.

PurchasedTime.description: Meaning undocumented; also appears per-Parallel-Event under Events.PE.<id>.

events.popupinfo.description: Per-event popup display tracking, e.g. {"<event-key>": {"shownCount": int, "shownAt": ISO-8601}}. Passed through as-is, not validated by the tooling.

Unknown.description: Forward-compatibility bucket for root-level keys the schema doesn't recognize yet - preserved losslessly rather than dropped.

anyOf.description: Rare fallback: pending Task entries when no active LTE (Events.Current) was found to attach them to.

bitmask.description: Bit index (string) -> true for set bits. A missing key means that bit is unset - this is sparse, not dense.

unknownField.description: Forward-compat escape hatch for a raw key not yet in tools/save_schema.py's registry. raw_suffix preserves the original int("i")/float("f")/long("")/bare(null) distinction so it round-trips exactly.

bitmaskOrRawFallback.description: Normally a bitmask object; falls back to a raw-preserving wrapper on the rare save where this blob field doesn't decode as expected (observed real examples: GirlsUnlocked:19i as a plain int, PlayfabAwardedItems as a bare non-base64 scalar).

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 datetime (microsecond precision - the raw format's 100ns ticks are truncated on decode), or the literal sentinel "N/A" (raw int64.max, "needs an unlock requirement"/no history) or "never" (raw 0, not yet reached).

flingProgress.description: Decoded C<N>P conversation-state blob (see tools/phone_fling.py), or null when the blob is empty (fling never started, Date == "never").

unknown_1.description: Unconfirmed meaning - possibly a sent-only message counter.

next_message_countdown.description: 4294967292 (0xFFFFFFFC) is a "conversation gated, no countdown running" sentinel, not a literal countdown.

trailing.description: Unparsed trailing bytes as lowercase hex - meaning unconfirmed.

Date.description: Utc-kind. Time of last message received/viewed.
Raw GameState.DateCount - unconfirmed whether this truly means total dates gone on.

Gift.description: Raw GameState.GiftCount - total gifts given across all girls.

Heart.description: Raw GameState.HeartCount - total affection points across all girls.

Poke.description: Raw GameState.PokeCount - times girls have been poked.

Pending.description: Raw GameState.PendingMultiplier - current pending Reset Boost multiplier.

Purchased.description: Raw GameState.PurchasedMultiplier - multiplier obtained via purchase.

Time.description: Raw root TimeMultiplier (or per-PE pes<N>TimeMultiplier) - moved here despite not being GameState-prefixed in the raw save.

gameStateObject.description: Shared shape for root GameState and each Parallel Event's own mirrored GameState block.

Date.description: Local-kind. Matches DateUTC to the millisecond.

Hobbies.description: Count or bitmask of unlocked hobbies - shape unconfirmed.

Seconds.description: Elapsed seconds counter - reference point unconfirmed.

TotalTime.description: Lifetime total play time - unit unconfirmed.

Timeline.description: Time Warp PE only - current Timeline the player is in.

TimeCrystalCount.description: Time Warp PE only - Time Crystals obtained this event.

TimelineComplete.description: Undocumented, seen on the Switch sample - meaning unconfirmed.

Boost2EndTime.description: Likely a mobile-version holdover; ad-powered Speed Boost end timestamp. Observed on PC too despite the name.

TimeSkip2EndTime.description: Likely a mobile-version holdover; ad-powered Time Skip end timestamp.

Created.description: Utc-kind. Likely save/account creation timestamp. Defaulted from DateUTC when encoding a PC-sourced JSON to Switch, since no real history exists to draw from.

DateOffset.description: Likely clock-drift/timezone offset paired with Date/DateUTC.

Covid2020.description: Likely a flag for the short COVID-themed phone fling.

DisableCloud.description: Cloud backup disabled for this save file.

skillObject.description: Hobby-skill levels 0-75, keyed by internal hobby ID (not alphabetical) as a numeric string "0"-"11", paired with Hobby entries by in-game order.

Experience.description: Total XP earned in this job.

Locked.description: Naming is inverted from its meaning in the raw save - likely a dev typo, per docs/SCHEMA.md.

Time.description: Total time invested in this Hobby.

TimeL.description: Time invested in this Hobby for the current level.

Dates.description: The Date required for progression this level.

Life.description: Lifetime-accumulated bitmasks, as opposed to this girl's current Dates/Clothing above.

Dates.description: Was raw LifeDates - all Dates completed lifetime for this girl.

Outfits.description: Was raw LifeOutfits - lifetime unlocked outfits/costumes.

Gifts.description: Was raw LifeGifts - meaning unconfirmed, handled the same shape as Dates/Outfits.

LoveHighMark.description: Time Warp PE only. Highest Love reached this event, prevents re-earning Time Crystals for already-hit levels after a soft reset.

^GiftCount[0-9]*$.description: Sparse - only present slots have made progress.

^DateCount[0-9]*$.description: Sparse - only present slots have made progress.

eventsPeEntry.description: One Parallel Event's mirrored state. Not every PE populates every field - e.g. only Time Warp uses GameState.Timeline/TimeCrystalCount and Girls.<name>.LoveHighMark.

Hobby.description: Each PE uses its own 12-hobby name vocabulary, different from root's.

Goals.description: Bitmask of goals culminating in unlocking the PE's reward.

Start.description: Utc-kind. When the player started this event.

Unknown.description: Forward-compatibility bucket for this PE's unrecognized keys.

Tokens.description: Token/currency count for this LTE. The save typically only populates the current and previous event's Tokens.

Tasks.description: Present only for the LTE matching Events.Current - keyed by task number (string).

Price.description: Raw value passed through unchanged - not decoded from its ~(x+1) shop-cost encoding.

Quantity.description: Raw value passed through unchanged - not decoded from its ~(x+1) shop-cost encoding.
